presentation: Independent classic arcade lobby and neutral plastic handheld shell; no StatOz visual tokens/fonts. Responsive landscape handheld; original source-studied stadium geometry, distance-based strides, stable-head counter-strides, facing hysteresis and target-facing deliveries. Sliding eight-way mobile controls; explicit P/L/S attack and T/S/D defence buttons; arrow-key movement; original short standing challenge and full sliding challenge; source-inspired pitch SHOOT cue with authored trigger and HUD exclusion; optional 320x224 reference framing. Reference-calibrated 23x4.5 pitch projection; uniform 0.8 pitch actors with shared contact anchors; derived stadium/camera extents and kickoff spacing. Native timing and depth perspective unverified.
